title: geoproc.subbasin_delineation task kwargs
description: Canonical: geoai-django contracts/geoproc/subbasin_delineation.v1.json; vendored copy in flood_snap lab_service/contracts/. Subbasins of one delineated basin the way QSWAT+ delineates a SWAT+ watershed: the river layer burnt into the DEM, a subbasin per stream link, the gauges as outlets that split their link (flood_snap lab_service/subbasins). The done event carries result.kind = subbasin_delineation, result.stats (summary, audit, gauges, table), metadata, config_hash and the products subbasins (GeoJSON), subbasin_streams (GeoJSON), subbasin_table (CSV).

job_id.description: the platform Job id (UUID); also the Celery task id

basin_id.description: the BasinDelineation the subbasins belong to; its snapped outlet is sent below

stream_threshold_km2.description: drainage area at which a channel starts; smaller = more subbasins

burn_depth_m.description: depth the river layer is burnt into the DEM (QSWAT+ default 50 m); 0 = no burn-in

gauges.description: hydrometric posts inside the basin; each becomes a subbasin outlet

area_km2.description: official catchment area: the snap prefers the channel cell whose drainage area is closest

rivers.description: the river layer to burn: GeoJSON FeatureCollection of LineStrings in EPSG:4326 (properties name, river_id), clipped to the basin's bounding box
